intent.instructions: Primary action the user wants, as a short phrase.

entities.instructions: Named ids, repos, files, channels, titles mentioned.

prohibitions.instructions: Complete do-not / never phrases retaining negation.

ask_triggers.instructions: Conditions that require asking the user first.

needs_generation.instructions: yes if free-form drafting is required, no otherwise.

multi_part.instructions: yes if the request has independent subtasks, no if single.

irreversible.instructions: yes if an irreversible act is requested, no, or unclear.
